ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, given $\triangle ABC\sim \triangle ADE$, $AD=6$, $BD=3$, $DE=4$, what is the length of $BC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution}: Since $AD=6$ and $BD=3$,\\
then $AB=9$,\\
Since $\triangle ABC\sim \triangle ADE$ and $DE=4$,\\
then $AD: AB = DE: BC$,\\
thus $BC=\frac{AB\cdot DE}{AD}$,\\
Since $DE=4$,\\
thus $BC=\frac{9\times 4}{6}=\boxed{6}$.
